mathematical_formulation.label: Y_i = customer FLAG in {0,1}
mathematical_formulation.loss: Unweighted binary cross-entropy over customer bags only

pooling_variants.name: MEAN
pooling_variants.definition: Mask-aware arithmetic mean of valid instance embeddings

pooling_variants.name: MAX
pooling_variants.definition: Mask-aware elementwise maximum over valid instance embeddings

pooling_variants.name: GATED_ATTENTION
pooling_variants.definition: a_ij = softmax_j(w^T[tanh(V h_ij) elementwise_multiply sigmoid(U h_ij)]); z_i = sum_j a_ij h_ij

training.loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss with no class or instance weights
training.early_stopping: none; the fixed 50-epoch budget prevents DEV_VAL-driven epoch selection
training.shuffle: DEV_TRAIN bag order once per epoch using the run seed
training.sampling: Every eligible DEV_TRAIN customer appears exactly once per epoch; no label-dependent sampling

variable_length_implementation.choice: Padded small bag batches with a boolean validity mask and custom collate function
variable_length_implementation.mask_semantics: True for a real instance and False for padding; masked positions cannot contribute to any pool
variable_length_implementation.estimated_total_training_memory: Well below 1 GiB including model, optimizer, masks, gradients, and activations; the full SUMMARY_17 development matrix is 49.86 MiB
variable_length_implementation.cpu_runtime_estimate: Approximately 2–10 minutes per 50-epoch fit and 0.5–2.5 hours for all 15 fixed pooling/seed fits; verify empirically in Stage 24B
variable_length_implementation.gpu_runtime_estimate: A GPU is optional, not required. The audited environment has CPU-only PyTorch 2.13.0 and no CUDA device.

chronology_policy.rationale: Isolate bag-level weak supervision before introducing temporal sequence modelling
chronology_policy.interpretation: The model may identify decision-relevant instances independent of ordering; it does not model temporal dynamics
